theater: 尼羅河三角洲東緣比路斯

battle.name: 穆斯林征服埃及
battle.theater: 尼羅河三角洲東緣比路斯
battle.brief: 639 年冬阿拉伯軍越過西奈半島進入埃及，與拜占庭—科普特聯軍在尼羅河三角洲東緣的開闊沙地上數度交鋒。640 年初比路斯一役阿拉伯騎兵先敗後勝，孟菲斯隨後陷落；阿拉伯人分割包圍、切斷馬里亞運渠，亞歷山大里亞於 641 年 11 月開城。卡面的秦連弩並未參戰，只能與拜占庭城頭的連續射擊火力作對照。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 交戰雙方是尚在成形中的阿拉伯哈里發國，與拜占庭帝國在埃及的行省。阿拉伯方面，名義上的最高決策者是哈里發歐麥爾·伊本·哈塔卜，但實戰由兩位指揮官分頭推進：敘利亞戰線的大軍統帥艾卜·歐拜德·伊本·賈拉赫負責率主力越過西奈半島，埃及方面的戰場指揮官阿姆魯·伊本·阿斯則率騎兵先行突入，穆阿維葉·伊本·阿比·蘇菲揚任其副手並兼管海路。哈里發國的軍隊以阿拉伯部落的徵召兵為主，輔以改宗後的阿拉伯騎兵，編制仍是部族聯軍式的鬆散結構，沒有固定營區，靠分隊劫掠與就地徵發維持作戰，糧秣主要取自尼羅河沿岸的莊園與村鎮。拜占庭方面，埃及是帝國在非洲僅存的核心行省，行政樞紐在亞歷山大里亞，行省總督是皇帝希拉克略任命的基魯斯；三角洲一線的野戰軍由拜占庭與高加索系的混合部隊組成，提奧多羅這位加比亞納出身的波斯裔宦官統率一軍，格魯吉亞籍的帕特里基統率另一軍，兩軍指揮系統互不統屬。除正規軍之外，亞歷山大里亞的城防部隊、尼羅河三角洲密集的運河與灌溉莊園、科普特教會與希臘裔為主的城市商民，都是這場衝突裡不可忽略的第三方力量。
countriesEn: The two parties were the still-forming Arab caliphate on the one side and the Egyptian province of the Byzantine Empire on the other. Nominally the supreme decision-maker on the Arab side was the caliph Umar ibn al-Khattab, but in the field the campaign was carried forward by two commanders working separately: Abu Ubaidah ibn al-Jarrah, who led the main body across the Sinai from the Syrian theatre, and Amr ibn al-As, who led the cavalry into Egypt ahead of him, with Mu'awiya ibn Abi Sufyan as his lieutenant and the man in charge of the sea route. The army of the caliphate was drawn chiefly from the levies of the Arab tribes, reinforced by Arab cavalry who had already converted; in organisation it remained a loose tribal confederation with no standing camps, sustained in the field by raiding and by taking what it needed from the country it passed through, and its grain came mainly from the estates and villages along the Nile. On the Byzantine side Egypt was the last great African province of the empire, with Alexandria as its administrative centre and with Cyrus, appointed by the emperor Heraclius as eparch, at the head of the province. The field army in the Nile delta was a mixed Byzantine and Caucasian force, one division led by Theodoros, a Persian-born eunuch from Gabiana, another by a Georgian patrician, and neither commander was subordinate to the other. Besides the regular forces, the garrison of Alexandria, the dense web of canals and irrigated estates in the delta, the Coptic church and the Greek-speaking townsmen and merchants were all third parties of no small weight in this conflict.
people: 核心人物是阿姆魯·伊本·阿斯。這位綽號「獨眼」的老兵在 625 年歐都斯戰役中傷失一目，630 年麥加之役後改宗，是哈里發國在埃及方向唯一能獨當一面的統帥，他所率的騎兵常被引述為約兩萬，並以分割包圍與斷水的方法而非正面強攻著稱。哈里發歐麥爾是所有重大決策的拍板者：他批准追擊埃及、批准與亞歷山大里亞談判的條件，並批准在開羅設立埃及的軍政衙門。副手穆阿維葉·伊本·阿比·蘇菲揚在此役中負責建造與指揮海軍，在紅海北端的艾因·蓋拉設船塢，率船隊駛入地中海，直接威脅拜占庭的海上補給線，他此後建立的敘利亞海軍與克里米特遠征軍，都以這段造船經驗為基礎。艾卜·歐拜德·伊本·賈拉赫是敘利亞戰線的總指揮，征服埃及在他的整體戰略中只是承上啟下的一環。拜占庭方面，除坐鎮君士坦丁堡、忙於籌劃對波斯人反攻的希拉克略皇帝本人之外，真正左右埃及局勢的是總督基魯斯，他早年曾奉命出使北方草原的契丹（唐國）求援，這段經歷使他在與阿拉伯人談判時相當冷靜，最後與阿姆魯達成開城條件，換取基督教社團的自主與個人俸祿，隨後被送往麥地那養老。野戰指揮官提奧多羅與格魯吉亞籍帕特里基互相輕視，競相退兵，成為阿拉伯軍得以各个擊破的關鍵。黑人宣禮者比拉爾·伊本·拉巴隨軍抵達埃及，在新興的開羅聚落中擔任宣禮，這是伊斯蘭禮拜制度在埃及落地最早的痕跡之一。
peopleEn: The central figure was Amr ibn al-As. This veteran, nicknamed the one-eyed, had lost an eye at the Battle of Uhud in 625 and converted after the conquest of Mecca in 630, and he was the only commander on the Egyptian front capable of operating on his own; his cavalry is commonly given as about twenty thousand, and he was distinguished less by frontal assault than by the division of the enemy and by cutting its water. The caliph Umar was the man who settled every decision of consequence: he approved the pursuit into Egypt, he approved the terms of the negotiation with Alexandria, and he approved the establishment of the Egyptian military and administrative office at Fustat. His lieutenant Mu'awiya ibn Abi Sufyan was responsible in this campaign for building and commanding the fleet; he set up a shipyard at Ayn Ghar near the head of the Red Sea and sailed into the Mediterranean, directly threatening the Byzantine sea line of supply, and the Syrian fleet and the Crimus expedition that he built later both grew out of that experience of shipbuilding. Abu Ubaidah ibn al-Jarrah commanded on the Syrian front, and the conquest of Egypt was only one link in his general strategy. On the Byzantine side, apart from the emperor Heraclius himself, who sat at Constantinople occupied with plans for a counter-stroke against the Persians, the man who shaped events in Egypt was the eparch Cyrus. He had earlier been sent on an embassy to the Khitans of the northern steppe, the Chinese Tang state, to ask for help, and that experience left him remarkably cool in his negotiations with the Arabs; in the end he struck terms with Amr that opened the city in exchange for the autonomy of the Christian communities and a personal stipend, and he was then sent to Medina to live out his days. The field commanders Theodoros and the Georgian patrician despised each other and raced to stand aside from the fighting, and that was the crack through which the Arabs were able to break the enemy piece by piece. The black muezzin Bilal ibn Rabah came to Egypt with the army and called the prayer in the new settlement of Fustat, one of the earliest traces of the Islamic institution of prayer taking root in Egypt.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是秦連弩，戰國末期至漢末中國的弩機改進之作：弩臂以木或複合材料製成，弦由腳踏的蹶張機構拉滿並把張力存進弩機，矢匣裝填後可連續擊發，後世文獻誇稱一次上弦能發數十箭，實際有效射程約一百五十米上下。它是典型的固定防守型短程連續射擊武器，用途就是從城頭把逼近的攻城者壓在牆外。本次征服埃及的戰場上不可能有這種兵器，卡面只能用來作對照：真正扮演「連續射擊壓制攻城者」這個角色的，是亞歷山大里亞城頭的拜占庭弓箭手與守城投射機，以及巴比倫要塞這類石造城塞；而把攻城者擋在牆外這件事，在埃及靠的是分割包圍與切斷運河水源，不是靠一具可以連發的弩機。阿拉伯軍的裝備以騎兵為核心：大量馬匹與數千頭駱駝、複合反曲弓、薩伊夫式彎刀、長矛與標槍、皮革甲與鐵環甲，以及隨軍攜帶的帳幕與水袋；步兵是配短刀與投槍的輕裝散兵，攻城時使用撞槌、雲梯，並靠挖掘壕溝與封鎖道路減緩守軍反擊，軍中另備渡河用的輕舟與紮營的器械。拜占庭軍的裝備體系更為完整：鱗甲或環甲、圓盾、長劍與雙刃劍、標槍與弓箭，守城則依靠石牆、角樓、弩炮與投石機；埃及本地部隊另有大量運河中的駁船與尼羅河上的糧船，運力正是拜占庭得以長期固守亞歷山大里亞的前提。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Chinese repeating crossbow, a refinement of the crossbow mechanism produced in China between the late Warring States period and the late Han: the bow stave was of wood or composite, the string was drawn to full tension by a treadle and stored in the mechanism, and once the magazine was loaded the weapon could fire repeatedly, later texts boasting of dozens of bolts from a single cocking, with an effective range of around one hundred and fifty metres. It is the typical fixed defensive short-range weapon of sustained fire, its purpose being to hold the attacker down under the wall. Nothing of the kind could have existed on the battlefield of the conquest of Egypt, so the card serves only as a comparison: the role actually played by sustained fire against attackers was that of the Byzantine archers and the siege engines on the walls of Alexandria, and of stone fortresses such as Babylon; and what held the attackers outside the walls in Egypt was the division of the enemy and the cutting of the canal water, not a crossbow mechanism that could fire in sequence. The equipment of the Arab army was built around cavalry: a great many horses and several thousand camels, composite recurve bows, saif-type curved sabres, long spears and javelins, hide armour and iron-ringed mail, together with tents and water skins carried on campaign. Their infantry were light troops armed with short swords and javelins; at sieges they used battering rams and ladders, and slowed the counter-stroke of the defenders by digging trenches and closing roads, while the army also carried light boats for river crossings and the gear for pitching camp. The equipment system of the Byzantine army was more complete: scale or ring armour, round shields, long swords and spathae, spears and bows, and for the defence of walls, masonry, flanking towers, bolt-throwers and stone-throwing engines. The Egyptian local troops had in addition large numbers of canal barges and Nile grain boats, and that transport capacity was precisely what allowed Byzantium to hold Alexandria for so long.
tactics: 阿拉伯軍的戰術核心是騎兵機動與分割包圍，不與守軍正面硬拼。第一步是越過西奈半島的沙丘地帶，靠嚮導與水源知識控制行程；面對拜占庭在三角洲東緣的沼澤、鹽鹼地與運河屏障，隊伍沿乾河床推進，避開運河交叉的防守要點，並以分隊劫掠的方式讓隨軍糧秣不斷滾動。第二步是誘敵出城：640 年初在比路斯一線，阿拉伯騎兵與拜占庭的兩支縱隊在開闊沙地上互相夾擊，阿姆魯的部隊一度被壓制，他本人腿部負傷，撤退重整後捲土重來，趁對方兩軍指揮不統一之際各個擊破。第三步是分割包圍：孟菲斯陷落後，阿拉伯人不去強攻亞歷山大里亞的城牆，而是封鎖海陸通道、切斷由尼羅河通向地中海的馬里亞運渠，使城內的淡水與糧食日漸吃緊，同時以圍城中的機動作戰消耗守軍耐心。對照卡面的秦連弩，這場戰役呈現出截然不同的技術取向：連弩的價值在於固定防點上的持續壓制火力，而阿拉伯軍整套打法恰恰是讓守軍沒有可依托的固定射擊陣地；拜占庭守軍在城頭的弓箭與投射機本可與連弩的作用相提並論，但遭到分割圍困與水源切斷之後，這些固定火力點未能發揮作用。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of the Arab army was mounted mobility and the division of the enemy, not a frontal match of strength. The first step was to cross the dune belt of the Sinai and keep the march under control by means of guides and knowledge of the water; facing the marshes, salt flats and canal barriers that Byzantium held on the eastern edge of the delta, the columns pushed along the dry riverbeds, avoided the points where the canals crossed, and kept their supplies rolling by raiding in separate parties. The second step was to draw the enemy out of the cities: early in 640 at the line of Bilus, the Arab cavalry and the two Byzantine columns closed on each other in the open sand and attacked from both flanks; the force of Amr was pressed and he was wounded in the leg, and after withdrawing to re-form he came back and beat the two hostile armies one at a time while their command was not united. The third step was the blockade: after Memphis fell, the Arabs did not assault the walls of Alexandria with force, but closed the land and sea approaches, cut the Maria canal that carried water from the Nile to the Mediterranean, so that water and grain inside the city grew steadily shorter, and wore out the patience of the defenders with mobile operations around the siege. Set against the repeating crossbow on the card, the campaign shows a completely different technical logic: the value of the repeating crossbow lay in sustained fire from a fixed point of defence, and the whole Arab method was precisely to leave the defenders no fixed position from which to shoot. The archers and the engines on the walls of Alexandria might have played the part of the repeating crossbow, but once they were divided, blockaded and cut off from the river water, those fixed points of fire did not do their work.
data: 時間線與可核對的數字如下。639 年冬（回曆二十年），艾卜·歐拜德率軍自加沙方向進入埃及，先取沿海的佩利姆一帶，這是阿拉伯人首次踏入埃及。640 年初在比路斯（Bilus，今沙爾基亞省比爾貝斯一帶）與拜占庭—埃及聯軍首次大戰，阿拉伯軍先敗後勝。641 年初孟菲斯淪陷，阿姆魯在尼羅河東岸建立營地，翌年在此建起清真寺，該處即開羅（al-Fustat）聚落的雛形。641 年 11 月，亞歷山大里亞依協議開城，部分史料把日期繫於 642 年。642 年初，阿拉伯遠征軍的後續部隊與艦隊抵達埃及，開始最後的攻堅；阿赫明據點於 642 年陷落，三角洲北部的巴克利斯（Baralis）守軍抵抗到 645 年，開城之後拜占庭在埃及的據點才全部清除。兵力的量級只能視為約數：投入埃及的阿拉伯軍常被引述為一萬五千至二萬人，另有數千駱駝；拜占庭與埃及的野戰聯軍常被估為一萬至一萬五千人，各要塞另有守軍。希拉克略曾籌劃由海路運兵赴埃及，編年史提到上千艘的艦隊與大批船員，終因地中海東岸的形勢崩壞而未能成行。亞歷山大里亞的人口，古代作者的估計從數萬到數十萬都有，較保守者認為城內居民約四萬至五萬。開羅在征服當時只是營地，數十年後已成為伊斯蘭世界最大的城市之一，與君士坦丁堡同級的巨城。
dataEn: The datable points and the figures that can be checked are as follows. In the winter of 639, the twentieth year of the Hijra, Abu Ubaidah led his men into Egypt from the direction of Gaza and first took the coastal strip around Pelusium; this was the first time Arab soldiers set foot in Egypt. Early in 640, at Bilus, in what is now the vicinity of Bilbeis in Sharqia province, came the first great battle against the Byzantine-Egyptian combined force; the Arab army was beaten first and won afterwards. In the early months of 641 Memphis fell, Amr pitched his camp on the east bank of the Nile, and in the following year the mosque was built there, on the site that became the nucleus of the settlement of Fustat. In November 641 Alexandria opened its gates by agreement, though some accounts date the surrender to 642. At the beginning of 642 the follow-up body of the Arab expedition and its fleet reached Egypt and the last sieges began; the fortress of Akhmim fell in 642, and the garrison of Baralis in the north of the delta held out until 645, after whose surrender the last Byzantine foothold in Egypt was gone. The sizes of forces can only be treated as approximations: the Arab force committed to Egypt is commonly put at fifteen to twenty thousand men together with several thousand camels; the Byzantine-Egyptian field army is generally estimated at ten to fifteen thousand, with separate garrisons in each fortress. Heraclius planned to bring troops to Egypt by sea, the chroniclers speak of a fleet of a thousand vessels or more with large numbers of crews, and in the end nothing came of it because the situation on the eastern Mediterranean had collapsed. The population of Alexandria is estimated by ancient authors anywhere from tens of thousands to several hundred thousand, the more conservative figure being some forty to fifty thousand inhabitants within the walls. Fustat was nothing but a camp at the time of the conquest; within a few decades it was the largest city in the Islamic world, on a par with Constantinople itself.
cause: 打起來的原因有四層。第一層是拜占庭與薩珊帝國長達二十六年（602-628）的消耗戰：戰爭拖垮了帝國的財政與兵源，希拉克略雖在 628 年擊敗波斯人、奪回失地，帝國的遠征能力卻已耗盡。第二層是薩珊的敗亡改變了整個平衡。634 年阿拉伯人滅薩珊，敘利亞、巴勒斯坦與西奈落入哈里發國之手；636 年耶穆克戰役中拜占庭主力崩潰，帝國在東方的邊界退到安納托利亞，埃及遂變成孤立的前線省份，它與君士坦丁堡之間的陸路補給線被切斷，海路又面臨阿拉伯海軍的威脅。第三層是哈里發國自身的戰略選擇：穆罕默德於 632 年病逝後，歐麥爾把敘利亞戰線的推進視為首要任務，同時需要一個穩定的南部基地與地中海的航路，好讓新奪得的敘利亞、埃及與阿拉伯本土連成一體。拜占庭方面的弱點在於皇帝本人正忙於對付波斯人與籌劃反攻，援軍的決策與調度都要時間；希拉克略曾企圖以阿拉伯人作為對付波斯的棋子，這一手在阿拉伯人統一之後反噬了自己的盟友。第四層原因在埃及內部：帝國晚期的埃及行省稅負沉重、軍餉常被拖欠，拜占庭駐軍與當地科普特人及希臘裔居民之間並不融洽，科普特教會雖屬尼西亞派，卻長期受當局壓迫。阿拉伯人並未自稱解放者，但宗教上的寬容與較低的稅賦，對受壓迫的當地人口構成了真實的吸引力。
causeEn: There were four layers of reason for the war. The first was the ruinous twenty-six year war between Byzantium and the Sasanian empire, from 602 to 628: it drained the treasury and the manpower of the empire, and although Heraclius beat the Persians in 628 and took back the lost provinces, the capacity of the empire to project force over long distances had been spent. The second was that the fall of the Sasanians changed the whole balance. In 634 the Arabs destroyed the Sasanian state, and Syria, Palestine and the Sinai passed to the caliphate; at the Battle of Yarmouk in 636 the main Byzantine army was broken, the eastern frontier of the empire was pulled back to Anatolia, and Egypt became an isolated forward province, its land line of supply to Constantinople cut through and its sea line exposed to an Arab fleet. The third was the strategic choice of the caliphate itself: after Muhammad died in 632, Umar made the advance on the Syrian front his first priority, and at the same time he needed a stable southern base and a sea lane in the Mediterranean so that the newly won Syria, Egypt and the Arabian homeland would be joined into one. The weakness on the Byzantine side lay in the fact that the emperor was himself occupied with the Persians and with planning a counter-stroke, while the decision and the dispatch of reinforcements took time; Heraclius had tried to use the Arabs as a piece against the Persians, and once the Arabs were united that gambit turned against his own ally. The fourth layer of reason lay inside Egypt: taxation on the late imperial Egyptian province was heavy and military pay was habitually in arrears, relations between the Byzantine garrison and the Copts and Greek-speaking inhabitants were not good, and the Coptic church, though it was Nicene, had long been under pressure from the authorities. The Arabs did not present themselves as liberators, but their religious tolerance and their lighter taxation offered the oppressed local population a real attraction.
impact: 這場征服是七世紀地中海世界的一次結構性轉折。埃及自此脫離拜占庭帝國，成為哈里發國的第三個行省（Misr），阿姆魯被任命為總督，他在開羅設立的軍政衙門與清真寺構成新王朝的權力核心。亞歷山大里亞開城而未遭洗劫，希臘裔居民得以保留教會與部分自治，亞歷山大里亞牧區在阿拉伯統治下繼續存在數百年，但已從君士坦丁堡的教會系統中切割出來，基督教世界的裂痕從此又深了一層。經濟與城市格局同樣被改寫：拜占庭時代的埃及是君士坦丁堡的糧倉與地中海沿岸的穀物出口地；歸附之後，埃及的穀物與亞麻織品改為供應哈里發國的都會與軍隊，開羅在幾十年內長成伊斯蘭世界最大的城市之一，阿姆魯清真寺所在的尼羅河畔隨後又湧現出大量清真寺、市集與船塢。學術上，希臘語在埃及的知識傳統逐漸退場，亞歷山大里亞的藏書與學院在征服後數代內衰微，但希臘語的醫學與天文文獻仍被譯成阿拉伯語傳入哈里發國，成為日後阿拔斯王朝科學革命的養料，這是這次征服最迂迴也最長遠的後果之一。軍事上，這場戰役也示範了一種新方法：以騎兵割斷敵方聯繫、分割包圍、以斷水與封鎖代替強攻，之後數十年裡阿拉伯軍在波斯與拜占庭戰線上反覆沿用；而阿拉伯人對科普特農村的土地稅安排，則使埃及的財政從此改由埃及自己負擔。
impactEn: This conquest was a structural turning point in the Mediterranean world of the seventh century. Egypt passed out of the Byzantine Empire and became the third province of the caliphate, Misr, with Amr appointed as its governor; the military and administrative office and the mosque he set up at Fustat formed the power core of the new order. Alexandria opened without sack, and the Greek inhabitants kept their churches and a measure of autonomy; the see of Alexandria continued to exist under Arab rule for centuries, but it had now been cut away from the ecclesiastical system of Constantinople, and the fissures in the Christian world grew one step deeper. The economic and urban pattern was rewritten as well: under Byzantium Egypt was the granary of Constantinople and the grain exporter of the Mediterranean coast; after the submission, its grain and linen were turned towards the cities and armies of the caliphate, and within a few decades Fustat had become the largest city in the Islamic world, with mosque, market and shipyard crowding the bank of the Nile around the mosque of Amr. Scholarly life changed too: the Greek learned tradition in Egypt faded out, and the library and the school of Alexandria declined within a few generations of the conquest, yet Greek medical and astronomical texts were still translated into Arabic and carried into the caliphate, and there they became the nourishment of the scientific revival of the Abbasid age; this is the most indirect and the most far-reaching of the consequences of the conquest. Militarily the campaign also demonstrated a new method: cavalry cutting the enemy's lines of contact, the division of the enemy, and the substitution of cutting water and blockade for frontal assault, a method the Arab armies used again and again on the Persian and Byzantine fronts in the decades that followed. The arrangement of the land tax on the Coptic villages also meant that from this point the fiscal burden of Egypt was carried by Egypt itself.
result: 到 642 年底，拜占庭在埃及的軍事統治實際上終結：孟菲斯與開羅一線的行政中樞落入哈里發國，亞歷山大里亞以談判而非攻破的方式開城，拜占庭經營了兩個半世紀的非洲行省就此易主。最後一批據點，包括阿赫明與三角洲北部的巴克利斯分別在 642 年與 645 年開城，此後再沒有能長期維持的拜占庭旗幟；645 年穆阿維葉的海軍在尼羅河口又擊敗拜占庭艦隊，帝國想從海上奪回埃及的努力就此破滅。拜占庭失去了北非的稅基與地中海東岸的關鍵港區，退守小亞細亞與希臘本土，國勢自此再未恢復。對阿拉伯哈里發國來說，征服埃及既是財富的取得，也是義務的取得：從此要維持一支常駐的埃及軍團、管理龐大科普特農村的土地稅、平衡希臘教會與穆斯林社區的關係，並長期應付三角洲不斷湧出的反抗。埃及的阿拉伯化與伊斯蘭化不是幾年之功，而是延續數百年的過程，至九、十世紀科普特人口才逐步轉為少數；開羅則在往後數世紀一直是埃及與伊斯蘭世界的樞紐。回頭看，這場戰役以較小的代價拿下拜占庭最富庶的屬地，終結了拜占庭在非洲的帝國，成為哈里發國向地中海西進的起點。
resultEn: By the end of 642 the military rule of Byzantium in Egypt was effectively over: the administrative centre at Memphis and on the Fustat line passed to the caliphate, and Alexandria opened by negotiation rather than by storm, and the African province that Byzantium had governed for two and a half centuries changed hands. The last strongholds, Akhmim and Baralis in the north of the delta, opened in 642 and 645 respectively, and after that no Byzantine banner was held there for any length of time; in 645 the fleet of Mu'awiya defeated the Byzantine fleet at the mouth of the Nile, and the empire's attempt to retake Egypt by sea was shattered. Byzantium lost the revenues of North Africa and the key harbours of the eastern Mediterranean, fell back on Asia Minor and the Greek mainland, and never recovered its strength. For the Arab caliphate the conquest of Egypt was at once a gain of wealth and an assumption of obligation: from that point it had to keep a permanent Egyptian army in the field, manage the land tax of the great Coptic villages, hold the balance between the Greek churches and the Muslim communities, and answer the rebellions that kept rising in the delta. The Arabisation and Islamisation of Egypt was not the work of a few years but a process running for centuries, and only in the ninth and tenth centuries did the Coptic population become a minority. Fustat remained the hinge of Egypt and of the Islamic world for the centuries that followed. Looking back, the campaign took the richest province of Byzantium at comparatively small cost, ended the Byzantine empire in Africa, and became the starting point of the caliphate's westward advance along the Mediterranean.
